description:
Goal
Do the painful structural cutover: remove RuntimeValueLayout/RuntimeInputLayout/the old RuntimeLane layout leaf as artifact authority and replace them with a root-scoped transport interner plus fact tables keyed by ShapeId, LaneId, and CallableId.

Required model
Shape = Nothing | Lane(LaneId) | Tuple(Vec<ShapeId>) | Callable(CallableId). ShapeId is an interned descriptor handle; tuple children are ShapeIds. LaneId describes one non-callable transported leaf and owns type/internal-repr/published-boundary-repr/codegen-repr facts. CallableId describes callable identity; target executable, capture shapes, capture lanes, local/direct status, materialization, published boundary contracts, and codegen facts are projections. ValueId and other semantic positions map to ShapeId separately. ExecutableNeed remains only the coarse pre-spine seed. Divergence remains is_empty(return_ty).

Strategy
Build the spine once from settled RuntimeDemand inside MaterializeRoot/transport planning. Every artifact rung carries ShapeId/TransportPlan references, not copied recursive layouts. Fact tables hold value-position shapes, lane facts, callable facts, executable return/input/resume/capture shapes, published boundary contracts, and codegen lane facts.

No bridge rule
Do not keep a committed path that derives RuntimeValueLayout from Shape or Shape from RuntimeValueLayout. Do not introduce shims, adapters, aliases, or dual-authority fixtures. If this cannot compile atomically split-wise, it is one large commit.

Removal target
RuntimeValueLayout, RuntimeInputLayout, the old RuntimeLane, abi_reprs()/lane_tys() on recursive layout, runtime_value_layout_from_demand, runtime_input_layout_from_demand, local_callable_layout as a layout builder, boundary_return_abi over layout, and artifact fields named return_layout/resume_layouts/entry_capture_layouts/runtime_params when they carry layouts rather than shape refs.

Checks
All tests from fz-hwn.19.1 green; cargo check --all-targets; rg confirms RuntimeValueLayout/RuntimeInputLayout/RuntimeLane are gone outside historical docs or migration notes that explicitly describe the removed model.
title: Transport spine: replace RuntimeValueLayout with interned ShapeId/LaneId facts in one cutover
